core.description: Calendar, date conversion, Community Suite, Time Machine, On This Day, local/browser utilities and D1-backed public content. No runtime secret is required beyond configured bindings/vars.

public.description: All core public surfaces plus signed FM/radio playback. At least one media relay signing secret is required.

full.description: Every optional account/notification/admin/AI feature in addition to the public product.

jyotish_ai.note: The deterministic Patro Bot, Rashifal publications and non-AI astrology calculations do not depend on this group.

optional.NASA_API_KEY: Optional APOD enhancement; astronomy retains non-key/fallback data paths.
optional.CRON_SECRET: Only authorizes manual HTTP cron endpoints. Cloudflare scheduled() invocations do not require it.
optional.RASHIFAL_SERVICE_TOKEN: Only used by the compatibility service-token-hash endpoint; public and personalized Rashifal use D1/native logic without it.
optional.PUBLIC_SITE_URL: Prefer the committed non-secret Worker variable for canonical production origin.

notes.TV_RELAY_SECRET: Existing migrated relay-signing secret; may satisfy the media_relay group by itself.
notes.RADIO_RELAY_SECRET: Dedicated alternative relay-signing secret for radio.
notes.Groq_API: Existing exact-case Groq key supported by the Cloudflare-native Jyotish handler.
notes.nvidia_api: Existing exact-case NVIDIA NIM fallback key supported by the Cloudflare-native Jyotish handler.
notes.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: Google Identity Services OAuth web client ID. Identity only; no Gmail/Drive scope.
notes.VAPID_SUBJECT: Normally a mailto: or https: contact URI.
notes.ADMIN_GOOGLE_SUBJECTS: Comma-separated Google subject IDs authorized for calendar admin.
notes.ADMIN_EMAILS: Fallback comma-separated verified Google emails authorized for calendar admin.
